search_space.description: Search space for tuning existing ltr_xgb_002 LambdaMART without changing features or evaluation protocol.

lambdarank_pair_method.reason: XGBoost exposes pair construction strategies for LambdaMART, but this first study isolates standard tree regularization and learning-rate effects.

lambdarank_num_pair_per_sample.reason: Pair sampling changes the ranking-loss construction itself; keep default until a separate methodology decision.

grow_policy.reason: Keeping default depthwise policy avoids introducing max_leaves as an additional interaction.

max_leaves.reason: Only relevant when grow_policy=lossguide; not enabled in v1.

num_boost_round.reason: Not sampled directly; full-ranking validation with early stopping selects iteration.
